evidence.quote: We estimate that the net proceeds to us from the sale of shares of our Class A common stock in this offering will be approximately $3.27 billion, based upon the initial public offering price of $102.00 per share and after deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and our estimated offering expenses.

The principal purposes of this offering are to increase our capitalization and financial flexibility, create a public market for our Class A common stock, and enable access to the public equity markets for us and our stockholders.
We intend to use the net proceeds we receive from this offering for general corporate purposes, including working capital, operating expenses, and capital expenditures.
